record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four units in appliesTo declare ZAP_CANNON in this production reference (all maxPP 100, range 3). Charjabug and Grubbin declare passive HATCH, Deoxys Attack declares ALIEN_DNA and Vikavolt declares none; those passives were not traced here. The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats.
record.summary: Single-target: the target is first given armor reduction and paralysis for the same duration (1000/2000/4000/8000 ms raw by stars), then takes SPECIAL damage (raw 25/50/100/200 by stars). Because armor reduction is applied before the damage, the damage of the same cast already meets the halved SPE_DEF. The crit flag is the cast's crit, rolled only with the ABILITY_CRIT effect.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not traced beyond the attacking-state gate.

effects.scaling: requested amount = raw table value. handleSpecialDamage applies AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost passed as true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by 1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor (0 with a Rocky Helmet on the target, minus 0.1 per Black Augurite of its player, not below 0).
effects.resolution: applied change: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) where SPE_DEF is Math.round(speDef / 2) when the target has armorReduction - and ZAP_CANNON has just set it, unless runeProtect blocked it - then rounds up, minimum 1 (other modifiers not traced in full). Blocked (takenDamage 0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce; those do not stop the two statuses, which are applied before the damage call. takenDamage includes shield damage; the return value is unused.

statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit (the strategy passes the raw duration)
statusEffects.applicationOrder: first, before the paralysis and the damage
statusEffects.guards: not applied with runeProtect; duration passes through applyStatusDurationReductions (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, HYDRATION x0.5, WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, then -10% per ODD_KEYSTONE of the target's player, rounded); the timer is replaced only if the new duration is longer
statusEffects.combatEffect: while armorReduction is set, DEF and SPE_DEF are halved (Math.round(value / 2)) when handleDamage resolves damage on the target; the Power Lens retaliation computation in handleSpecialDamage also halves SPE_DEF. Other users of status.armorReduction (items.ts:165) were seen but not read.

statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit: the strategy leaves apBoost at its default false, so triggerParalysis does not multiply by (1 + AP/100)
statusEffects.applicationOrder: second, after armor reduction and before the damage
statusEffects.guards: not applied with runeProtect or IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS; STORM weather multiplies the duration by 1.3, then by (1 - 0.2 x ELECTRIC_QUARTZ count of the target's player) if any; then applyStatusDurationReductions as above; the timer is replaced only if longer; a CHERI_BERRY holder eats the berry
statusEffects.combatEffect: a paralysed unit uses half speed for its attack cooldown (attacking-state) and its movement speed (move-speed), and cannot dodge basic attacks (handleAttack dodge check). Other uses of status.paralysis (bug-buzz, force-palm, zing-zap, synergies.ts, passives.ts) were seen but not read.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star values (200 damage, 8000 ms; also the fallbacks) are not reachable by the listed units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). Grubbin 25 / 1000 ms, Charjabug 50 / 2000 ms, Deoxys Attack and Vikavolt 100 / 4000 ms.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (range 3 for all four units, so the cast fires from range).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast re-applies both statuses; a shorter new duration does not shorten an existing timer.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 25/50/100 raw SPECIAL damage and 1000/2000/4000 ms of armor reduction and paralysis. Applied: damage x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], divided by (1 + 0.05 x halved SPE_DEF) when armor reduction took hold, rounded up, at least 1, plus untraced modifiers; status durations pass through target-side reductions (and STORM for paralysis) and never extend a longer existing timer; nothing is applied against runeProtect (and no paralysis against IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's modifiers between the SPE_DEF division and the minimum of 1 (items, damage-reduction effects) and after the shield/Shiny Charm/Fossil/Cover Band branches - only the SPECIAL SPE_DEF division, the floor of 1 and the takenDamage accumulation lines were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution outside ZAP_CANNON: only castAbility's roll (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false) and handleSpecialDamage's multiplier were read
Other readers of status.armorReduction and status.paralysis beyond those listed were not read
unresolved: Passives HATCH (Charjabug, Grubbin) and ALIEN_DNA (Deoxys Attack) were not traced; see candidates/07367c34/review-followups.md for the HATCH finding
